description: Unrun evaluation inputs and grading criteria. Structure checks do not verify model output or writing performance.

evals.prompt: Revise this observation for clarity without adding facts: Under condition A, we observed 12 samples for 2 h. The largest observed voltage deviation was 0.1 V. The observation applies only to condition A.
evals.expected_output: A clear observation that preserves all quantities, the observation's scope, and its evidentiary limits.
assertions: The sample count remains 12, the observation period remains 2 h, and the maximum observed deviation remains 0.1 V.
The deviation is described as observed, not as a guaranteed maximum.
The observation is limited to condition A.
No cause, product guarantee, or new test result is invented.

evals.prompt: Revise for clarity without changing the requirements: The administrator may restart the service only if a backup has completed. They must not disable audit logging, even after restarting.
evals.expected_output: A revision that preserves the restart permission, necessary backup condition, and prohibition on disabling audit logging.
assertions: Restarting remains permitted rather than required.
A completed backup remains a necessary condition, not a guarantee or instruction to restart.
Disabling audit logging remains prohibited before and after the restart.
The administrator remains the actor.

evals.prompt: Proofread only. Keep the first-person voice and UK spelling: I have wrote that the service was initialised and its colour changed.
evals.expected_output: I have written that the service was initialised and its colour changed.
assertions: The grammatical error is corrected to 'have written'.
The first-person voice is preserved.
The UK spellings 'initialised' and 'colour' remain unchanged.
The sentence is not unnecessarily restructured or expanded with new facts.

evals.prompt: Draft one sentence for a new English document with no specified locale or house style. Convey only this fact: a setting changes the colour of the label.
evals.expected_output: A concise sentence using the US spelling 'color' and preserving the supplied fact.
assertions: The new sentence uses US English, including 'color'.
It says that a setting changes the label's color.
It does not invent a color, condition, product behavior, or follow-up action.

evals.prompt: Organize this as a procedure without changing its meaning or executing anything: A backup must finish before an administrator runs `svcctl restart --safe`. Restarting interrupts active sessions; warn readers before they run the command. Do not add a verification command.
evals.expected_output: A procedure that states the completed-backup prerequisite and session-interruption warning before the unchanged command.
assertions: The backup must be complete before the restart command.
The administrator remains the actor.
The interruption warning appears before the restart action.
The command `svcctl restart --safe` is preserved exactly and is not executed.
No verification command or claimed execution result is added.

evals.prompt: Proofread only. Preserve the exact quoted title "Plan—apply; verify" and the code `tool --filter="a;b"`. Do not normalize punctuation.
evals.expected_output: A response that preserves the title, em dash, semicolon, and code exactly and does not invent punctuation errors.
assertions: The quoted title "Plan—apply; verify" remains exact if repeated.
The code `tool --filter="a;b"` remains exact if repeated and is not executed.
The em dash and semicolons are not treated as errors merely because of their form.
The punctuation is not used as evidence of AI authorship.

evals.prompt: Review only; do not save or edit files: The cache deletes each record after 30 seconds. The same record remains in the cache for at least 60 seconds.
evals.expected_output: A review finding that identifies the conflicting retention statements and asks for the authoritative behavior.
assertions: The finding identifies the conflicting 30-second and 60-second statements.
It does not select or invent the correct retention period.
It provides a useful question or suggestion for resolving the conflict.
No file modification is made or claimed.

evals.prompt: Draft a brief email using only these facts: the workshop is postponed and the new date has not been decided. Do not invent a reason or promise a follow-up.
evals.expected_output: A brief email that communicates the postponement and undecided date without adding unsupported facts or commitments.
assertions: Both the postponement and the undecided new date are stated.
No reason, new date, or follow-up promise is invented.
The result is an email rather than a technical procedure.

evals.prompt: Make this English sentence clearer using plain-language and STE-inspired principles. Can you certify that it conforms to ISO 24495-1 and ASD-STE100? Text: Users can use the tool.
evals.expected_output: A clearer sentence and an explicit statement that this skill cannot certify conformity.
assertions: The revision preserves capability rather than turning it into an obligation.
The response does not claim ISO or ASD-STE100 compliance or certification.
The response does not claim institutional approval or verification of a complete standard.

evals.prompt: Revise this sentence without guessing what either 'it' refers to: After updating it, restart it. No other context is available.
evals.expected_output: A clarification request or explicit ambiguity finding without assigning an invented referent.
assertions: The unclear referents are identified or a focused clarification is requested.
No component, document, person, or system is invented as the referent.
The order of updating before restarting is not reversed.

evals.prompt: Draft one sentence for a new English guide. The project style requires UK English. The only supplied fact is that a setting changes the color of the status label.
evals.expected_output: A concise sentence that uses 'colour' in accordance with the project style and preserves the supplied fact.
assertions: The explicit project style takes precedence over the new-document US default.
The sentence uses the UK spelling 'colour'.
The label and the effect of the setting remain unchanged, with no invented details.

evals.prompt: Polish this sentence without strengthening its claim: The change might reduce latency; no measurements have been taken.
evals.expected_output: A clear sentence that preserves both the possibility of reduced latency and the absence of measurements.
assertions: Reduced latency remains a possibility, not a confirmed result or guarantee.
The absence of measurements remains explicit.
No measurement, percentage, cause, or validation is invented.

evals.prompt: Rewrite this requirement clearly without changing its boundaries or units: The sensor reading must be below 25 °C and at least -3 °C.
evals.expected_output: A requirement preserving the exclusive 25 °C upper bound and the inclusive -3 °C lower bound.
assertions: The upper boundary remains strictly below 25 °C.
The lower boundary remains at least -3 °C, including -3 °C.
The negative sign, values, units, and mandatory status remain unchanged.

evals.prompt: Please save a proofread version of this text to a file: The service respond slowly. I have not given you a file path.
evals.expected_output: A request for the destination path without creating a default file or claiming a successful save.
assertions: The response asks for a destination because no file path was supplied.
No default file is created and no successful save is claimed.
Any corrected text offered while awaiting the path does not imply that it was saved.
